description: Affordable and accessible public healthcare is vital to any prosperous state and economy. Iowa, particularly rural Iowa, is seeing a exodus of providers and healthcare facilities. We must act now to strengthen public access to healthcare services and offer incentives for physicians to come and practice in our state.
